title: Signing Breece Hall was priority for Jets, who view him as foundational piece

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Signing Breece Hall was priority for Jets, who view him as foundational piece
sources.description: After tagging Breece Hall in March, Jets GM Darren Mougey's plan never changed and believed he and Hall's agent were close to an extension. On Friday, both sides agreed to a deal.
